title: Proportionality Statement
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the binding energy is proportional to A.

title: Coefficient Value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the numerical value of the coefficient as 15.6 MeV.

title: Understanding A Dependence
description: Important Criteria: The response should explain the saturation property of nuclear forces and why binding energy is proportional to A.

title: Nucleon-Nucleon Forces
description: Important Criteria: The response must identify nucleon-nucleon forces as short-range forces.

title: Neutron Stability Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The response should explain why a neutron in a nucleus is stable against decay compared to a lambda particle in a hypernucleus.

title: Decay Energy Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The response may include the decay energy calculation for the neutron and its relevance to stability.

title: Units Mentioned
description: Optional Criteria: The response should mention the units of the coefficient (MeV).

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid stating that binding energy is proportional to A^2.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should not contain errors in the signs of energy values or decay processes.
